text: The Patriots' dominant third consecutive win over the Jets—a 26-19 triumph that improved them to 2-0 in the AFC East—came with a significant cost: Romeo Doubs suffered a shoulder injury while hauling in a 42-yard touchdown pass from Drake Maye early in the first quarter and has been placed on injured reserve, prompting the team to sign DB Elliott Davison to the active roster and cycle through practice squad moves with WR Ryan Miller, OL Jacob Rizy, and G Andrew Rupcich. While Maye's three touchdown passes led the charge, A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence due to a right high ankle sprain proved uneven, as he dropped a career-high three passes in what was otherwise a winning effort that exemplifies Head Coach Mike Vrabel's mantra of never apologizing for victories, even when execution shows clear room for improvement.
